_help: HubGPT Voice behavior settings. All machine-specific paths are in the HubGPT root config.json under paths; folder names are under layout.

recordings._exclude: file names to leave out (* = anything). Mahesh = not your voice.
recordings._help: your unscripted Audacity projects (.aup3, read-only). Lines are kept only when they sound like you (voice encoder >= speaker_min_similarity) and the Hindi checker was sure of the words (asr_min_logprob). Projects already imported with a script are skipped. Empty folders = skip this step.

dataset._asr: lines that only have a speech-recogniser transcript (no script) are kept when the recogniser was this sure
dataset._holdout: lines kept OUT of training - the A/B test speaks them and compares with your real recording

train._patience: stop when the kept-out lines have not improved for this many epochs
train._epochs: auto = about 2500 training steps, at least 4 and at most 15 epochs (small dataset -> more epochs) | a number
train._profile: default for train.bat: sukoon_calm (lines like your Sukoon delivery, from all recordings) | all
train._pitch_range: sukoon_calm keeps lines whose pitch is within this many semitones of your Sukoon pitch (your own lines vary ~ +-3; character voices are further away)
train._series_weight: how often each style's lines are shown per epoch (Sukoon is 56 of 268 min - x3 makes it about half, so the voice keeps your calm Sukoon pace and pauses)
train._help: LoRA = a small add-on (~30 MB) on top of Chatterbox's speech model; the shared model itself is never changed

speak._model: best = the newest training run's best checkpoint | base = plain Chatterbox clone (no training) | a path to a .pt file
speak._reference: auto = media_dir\dataset\refs\reference.wav (picked from your episodes) | path to any clean 6-10 s .wav of you
speak._settings: exaggeration 0.5 = what the training used (more = more dramatic, faster); cfg lower = slower, calmer
speak._s3gen: sound generator: base = Chatterbox's own | best = newest trained one (s3_* run) | a run name
speak._pace: trained voice: auto = your own measured pace for the style (Sukoon / story) | add words: 'slower', 'faster', 'more pauses', 'fewer pauses' (each once = one step; e.g. 'slower more pauses')
speak._tail: trained voice: how long the last word may be held / trail off before the line is ended (Chatterbox: 0.2 s, which cut your stretched endings)
speak._brakes: trained voice only: repetition_penalty (Chatterbox default 2.0 squeezes out pauses) and how many identical sound-pieces in a row end a line (25 = 1 s; Chatterbox ends at 2, which cuts every pause)
speak._match: trained voice: 'match to you' after each phrase - pitch moved to your measured Sukoon pitch (voice colour kept) and pace stretched toward yours, within these limits. false = off
speak._music: background music for narration_music.wav: a file, or a folder (one track picked). Your Sukoon episodes put music ~6-9 dB under your voice. with_music = also make the music version after every narration
speak._breaths: off | light | normal | more - your real Sukoon inhales (menu 6 builds the library) placed in pauses of at least breath_min_pause seconds
speak._pauses: seconds of silence after: a comma / a script line (your breath) / a sentence / '...' / '(...)' / a blank line. Your real recordings: ~1.3 s between lines
